split_definition.notes: Video IDs identical to the top-100 glosses of WLASL_v0.3.json; split membership per MRC LoadData.py at 810643c ('train' -> subsets train+val; anything else -> test).

metric_definitions.name: Top-1 classification accuracy, mean of 5 runs
metric_definitions.implementation: Paper Eq. (21); MRC code: sklearn accuracy_score on argmax of ridge-readout scores (reservoirs) or argmax softmax (Bi-GRU). Top-k for Table 2 via argsort of readout scores (MRC top_k_acc).
metric_definitions.version: MRC code 810643c (scikit-learn); exact versions to be pinned at run time
metric_definitions.aggregation: Mean over 5 repeated trainings with different random reservoirs/initialisations ('average of five experiments', Section 3)

metric_definitions.name: Top-5 classification accuracy
metric_definitions.implementation: MRC top_k_acc(k=5): true class among 5 highest readout scores
metric_definitions.aggregation: Assumed mean over 5 runs (paper does not state)

metric_definitions.name: Top-10 classification accuracy
metric_definitions.aggregation: Assumed mean over 5 runs (paper does not state)

metric_definitions.name: Standard deviation of top-1 accuracy over 5 runs
metric_definitions.implementation: numpy.std (population SD, ddof=0) as in MRC code

metric_definitions.name: Training wall-clock time
metric_definitions.implementation: MRC code: datetime difference around train_reservoir (reservoir state computation + model-space ridge + readout) or model.fit (Bi-GRU)

experiments.system: PBRC: two bidirectional ESN reservoirs (A, B), 70 nodes each, rho=0.3, alpha=0.6, tanh, shared W_r per reservoir for both directions, separate W_in,f and W_in,b; forward and time-reversed states concatenated per reservoir, then across reservoirs; ridge readout
experiments.checkpoint_rule: No checkpoint selection (closed-form ridge); 5 repeated runs; report mean/SD on test.
experiments.plan: MRC pipeline at 810643c (features, split, model-space representation with beta_embedding=15, readout beta=3, input scaling 0.3, connectivity 0.2, noise 0.01, n_drop 5) plus a reversed-time pass; evaluate on the 258 original test videos (no flipped copies).

experiments.system: BRC: one bidirectional ESN reservoir, 140 nodes
experiments.plan: As exp-pbrc with one reservoir of 140 nodes; rho/alpha not stated for BRC (gate: assume PBRC values).
MRC code with multiple_reservoir_number=1, 280 nodes; rho/alpha not stated for ESN.

experiments.checkpoint_rule: MRC Sign_language_BiGRUDropout.py ModelCheckpoint on val_accuracy, where the 'validation' set is the 258 test videos (as in the paper's split).
experiments.plan: MRC Sign_language_BiGRUDropout.py at 810643c (3 Bi-GRU blocks 128/64/32 with dense/dropout, Adam lr 1e-4, batch 32, 150 epochs).
